narratives.title: Documents and Letters - HMT Dunera and Internment Collection

CreCreationNotes: Hay Fever programme. Made from ink and watercolour on paper, with wool, Created by Paul G Glass in 1941 at Hay Camp, Australia. Belonged to Alfred Lewinsky.
PhyMedium: Ink and watercolour on paper, with wool
title: program - Hay Fever, 1941
CrePrimaryInscriptions: The programme is entirely handwritten and bears the following inscriptions. On the front page, the text reads "Recreation Department/Manager: S. Hochberger/The Camp Theatre presents: HAY FEVER." On the reverse, an annotation reads,"Programme designed by/ D. Paul G. Glass."
PhyTechnique: Ink line drawing with watercolour painting and handwritten text, bound with wool.
